text:
hao: I opened a release notes PR for the next docs push. Main bits: changelog entry for routing policy tweak, migration guide for embeddings stream -> batch, and an examples sweep for SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4402

jaz: Quick scan: the changelog paragraph reads fine but needs a clearer known-issue note about canary rollouts (some customers on older SDKs may get 404s if pinned to legacy model names).

mika: I'll add the note. Also, I found two broken anchors in the branch: `/guides/serve#prefix-cache` and `/docs/embedding#stream` -> both should point to `/reference/kv-cache` and `/reference/embeddings#migration`. I'll add redirects in the PR.

pat: For the SDK sweep: I updated Python and Go snippets to the new client shapes. I still need to update Rust and JS examples. JS has a rename in the alpha (`embeddings.create` -> `embeddings.embed`), so we should show both variants or specify client version.

hao: Good catch on JS. Let's include both and annotate which client version each snippet targets. That avoids confusion. Also need a one-line blurb for social: short and consumer-friendly. Any suggestions?

jaz: Draft blurb: "Docs: clearer routing defaults, embeddings migration guide, and updated SDK examples. Check the migration guide before upgrading." Shorter: "Docs update: migration guide + SDK examples for embeddings deprecation."

mika: Pushed redirect commit and fixed the anchors. Ran link-check locally; one external link flagged (old benchmark post) — replaced with archived copy.

docs-bot: link-checker: 0 anchors failing, 1 external warning cleared. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4402--docs.redwood.ai/ (expires in 7 days)

pat: Pushed JS + Rust snippets and annotated client-version notes. Also added a tiny YAML routing example for the relnotes showing opt-out: `routing_policy:
  preference: latency
  fallback: cost_variant`

hao: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: [x] redirects, [x] py/go snippets, [x] js/rust snippets, [x] known issues note, [x] blurb drafted. I'll merge once deploy preview checks pass and tag for release at 17:00 PT.
